text.text_excerpt: Great place! I'm down for wine and cheese probably 90% of anytime, but this place is a smart concept of picking your wines, cheeses, and meats and just letting them do the work of putting them together and adding the extra that you don't think about. Can't really remember all that they added but I loved the candied pecans and orange pieces with a nice smelly cheese and our semi dry Riesling. You think that this place is tiny just from walking in and seeing the space they have to choose your foods but when you walk outside and around the corner, they have this huge backyard and upstairs with tons of seating and a really chill vibe. I love this place. The food is fantastic and reasonably priced. You can get as much or as little as you want. The only minor downside (and once you work it out, it's no longer an issue) is that it's not immediately clear what the system is when you first walk in. In the wine shop, you can buy wine, cheese and deli meats. You choose the wine off the floor, and the cheese, etc from the cold cases. If you ask, for around $5, you can get bread, olives, fruit etc with the cheese and meat. A great meal alone, or as a starter with a group. Great wine selection, if a little on the pricey side. What an unexpected and lovely find in the ByWater area of New Orleans. Situated on the corner of an industrial block, this quaint wine shop turned live music venue and cocktail bar (upstairs) has become one of my favorite spots in NOLA. You will enter through the wine shop, you have the chance to purchase a bottle of wine (mark up is regular rate of 50-100%) or a glass of wine (daily offerings listed behind the counter). The glasses they offer in the shop are "funky" so if you're in the mood to try something different this may be your best bet.
